37: /-- If `b : ι → M` and `c : κ → N` are bases then so is `fun i ↦ b i.1 ⊗ₜ c i.2 : ι × κ → M ⊗ N`. -/
38: def tensorProduct (b : Basis ι S M) (c : Basis κ R N) :
39:     Basis (ι × κ) S (M ⊗[R] N) :=
40:   Finsupp.basisSingleOne.map
41:     ((TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.congr b.repr c.repr).trans <|
42:         (finsuppTensorFinsupp R S _ _ _ _).trans <|
43:           Finsupp.lcongr (Equiv.refl _) (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.rid R S S)).symm
44: 
45: @[simp]
46: theorem tensorProduct_apply (b : Basis ι S M) (c : Basis κ R N) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
47:     tensorProduct b c (i, j) = b i ⊗ₜ c j := by
48:   simp [tensorProduct]
49: 
50: theorem tensorProduct_apply' (b : Basis ι S M) (c : Basis κ R N) (i : ι × κ) :
51:     tensorProduct b c i = b i.1 ⊗ₜ c i.2 := by
52:   simp [tensorProduct]

55: theorem tensorProduct_repr_tmul_apply (b : Basis ι S M) (c : Basis κ R N) (m : M) (n : N)
56:     (i : ι) (j : κ) :
57:     (tensorProduct b c).repr (m ⊗ₜ n) (i, j) = c.repr n j • b.repr m i := by
58:   simp [tensorProduct]

62: /-- The lift of an `R`-basis of `M` to an `S`-basis of the base change `S ⊗[R] M`. -/
63: noncomputable
64: def baseChange (b : Basis ι R M) : Basis ι S (S ⊗[R] M) :=
65:   (tensorProduct (.singleton Unit S) b).reindex (Equiv.punitProd ι)

68: lemma baseChange_repr_tmul (b : Basis ι R M) (x y i) :

407: /-- If `S` a module-finite free `R`-algebra, then the `R`-rank of a nonzero `R`-free
408: ideal `I` of `S` is the same as the rank of `S`. -/
409: theorem Ideal.rank_eq {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [StrongRankCondition R] [Ring S] [IsDomain S]
410:     [Algebra R S] {n m : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype m] (b : Basis n R S) {I : Ideal S}
411:     (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (c : Basis m R I) : Fintype.card m = Fintype.card n := by
412:   obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Submodule.nonzero_mem_of_bot_lt (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr hI)
413:   have : LinearIndependent R fun i => b i • a := by
414:     have hb := b.linearIndependent
415:     rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff] at hb ⊢
416:     intro g hg
417:     apply hb g
418:     simp only [← smul_assoc, ← Finset.sum_smul, smul_eq_zero] at hg
419:     exact hg.resolve_right ha
420:   exact le_antisymm
421:     (b.card_le_card_of_linearIndependent (c.linearIndependent.map' (Submodule.subtype I)
422:       ((LinearMap.ker_eq_bot (f := (Submodule.subtype I : I →ₗ[R] S))).mpr Subtype.coe_injective)))
423:     (c.card_le_card_of_linearIndependent this)

428: theorem rank_pos_of_free [Module.Free R M] [Nontrivial M] :
429:     0 < Module.rank R M :=
430:   have := Module.nontrivial R M
431:   (pos_of_ne_zero <| Cardinal.mk_ne_zero _).trans_le
432:     (Free.chooseBasis R M).linearIndependent.cardinal_le_rank
433: 
434: theorem rank_pos_iff_of_free [Module.Free R M] :
435:     0 < Module.rank R M ↔ Nontrivial M := by
436:   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun _ ↦ rank_pos_of_free⟩
437:   rw [← not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial]
438:   intro h'
439:   simp only [rank_subsingleton', lt_self_iff_false] at h

441: theorem rank_zero_iff_of_free [Module.Free R M] :
442:     Module.rank R M = 0 ↔ Subsingleton M := by
443:   rw [← not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton, iff_not_comm,
444:     ← Module.rank_pos_iff_of_free (R := R), pos_iff_ne_zero]

446: theorem finrank_eq_nat_card_basis (h : Basis ι R M) :

450: /-- If a vector space (or module) has a finite basis, then its dimension (or rank) is equal to the
451: cardinality of the basis. -/
452: theorem finrank_eq_card_basis {ι : Type w} [Fintype ι] (h : Basis ι R M) :
453:     finrank R M = Fintype.card ι :=
454:   finrank_eq_of_rank_eq (rank_eq_card_basis h)
455: 
456: /-- If a free module is of finite rank, then the cardinality of any basis is equal to its
457: `finrank`. -/
458: theorem mk_finrank_eq_card_basis [Module.Finite R M] {ι : Type w} (h : Basis ι R M) :
459:     (finrank R M : Cardinal.{w}) = #ι := by
460:   cases @nonempty_fintype _ (Module.Finite.finite_basis h)
461:   rw [Cardinal.mk_fintype, finrank_eq_card_basis h]
